requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The original requirement combines a functional obligation (informing the security service) with a quality attribute (response time). Per Pohl (2025) §25.2, this is decomposed into two separate structured artefacts: a functional requirement and a quality requirement.

source_fragments: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service

fields.condition: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall inform the security service if the glass break detector of a window detects that the pane has been damaged.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall respond to damage notifications within 2 seconds at the latest.
